faq_sources.topic: How does a roofing crew get onto gated Fripp Island?
answer_facts: Gate staffed 24/7 by FIPOA Security (SLED-trained officers); security/gate 843-838-2334. FIPOA office 225 Tarpon Blvd, Mon-Fri 8:30-4:30, 843-838-4155.

FIPOA charges access fees to 'certain commercial vendors and service providers'. No access fee if the contractor has a Fripp Island Contractor decal. USPS/FedEx/UPS, utilities, emergency vehicles and a list of other service types are exempt. Concrete trucks $50 per trip (2026 manual). Daily-pass and yearly-decal dollar amounts sit in a table I could not read: NOT found.

Commercial decals are issued each April; bought in January the price is prorated to half; an annual commercial decal gets the provider listed on the POA Service Provider list. A vehicle with a business/contractor decal may do only business, commercial or construction activity on the island.

A contractor at the gate unprepared to pay 'will not be turned away' if Security can reach the owner and the owner assures payment within 14 days; Security emails the owner an IOU. Pay by cheque to FIPOA, at the office (cash/cheque/card), or mail to FIPOA, Attn SECURITY, 225 Tarpon Blvd.

Hours: sources give a weekend rule only - 'Contractors can only work on the weekend if permission has been given by Security', must be on a weekend worklist, quiet work only. No weekday hours found in any source read. The full Rules & Regulations (approved May 28, 2026, Access Control section) was not readable (link returned Not Found).
Owner side: guest passes via GateAccess.net / ABDI Gate Access App or Security 24/7 with property PIN.

faq_sources.topic: Does the Fripp Island property owners' association review roof replacements?
answer_facts: The Fripp Island Architectural Review Board (ARB) implements the covenants (design review); members appointed by the FIPOA Board; meets first and third Thursday of each month at 8:30 AM; applications due in the ARB office by 4:30 PM the Friday before the meeting. The ARB covers single-family properties; condominiums are handled by their regimes.

FIPOA's own ARB FAQ (2026 manual): 'Do I need ARB approval to repaint or re-roof my house the same color/material as it is now? No, but you still need to complete an application and post a permit; there is no cost.' The FAQ states review expressly for driveway material/colour changes, not for roofs - do not state more about a roof change than the sentence says.

Forms on the ARB page: Request for Exterior Alteration/Improvement Application, Checklist for Alterations/Improvements, Building Permit Application and Checklist. ARB Guidelines sit behind the homeowners' login - roofing-specific standards NOT found publicly.
Non-new-construction projects have 9 months from permit date to finish; daily fines after that unless an extension is filed.
sources: FIPOA New Homeowners Manual 2026, ARB FAQ (same PDF as above, read 2026-10-12)

faq_sources.topic: What roofing material holds up best on an oceanfront Fripp Island home? (cited facts only, no superlative)
answer_facts: SC adopted the 2021 SC Building Codes with an effective date of January 1, 2023 (SC Building Codes Council, LLR).

The Council's Beaufort County wind map is an image with 130 MPH and 140 MPH lines, labelled 'based upon the 2015 South Carolina Residential Code and a report to the SC Building Codes Council by Dr. Timothy Mays dated 6/30/2016'. I could not tell which line covers Fripp: no stated wind speed for Fripp found - do not print one.

FEMA (Hurricane Charley MAT report, Fact Sheet 3.3.1, NFIP Technical Bulletin 8; search summaries): within 3,000 feet of saltwater use stainless steel or hot-dip galvanized exposed roof fasteners; roofing nails, not staples; salt accumulation speeds corrosion; galvanizing wears off and stainless needs less maintenance; unsealed shingles were a common failure in high wind. Typical coverings listed: asphalt/wood shingles, tile, slate, metal.

IBHS FORTIFIED Roof (a voluntary standard, not code): 8d ring-shank nails (0.113 in x 2-3/8 in), sealed roof deck, no mandated roof cover but it must pass rated testing; 3,000-ft saltwater rule for hot-dip galvanized/stainless fasteners (2022 checklist).
No source read ranks one material 'best'. Manufacturer coastal-warranty notes: NOT searched in depth - NOT found.
Material or colour changes may go through FIPOA ARB (see the ARB answer).
